_about: Snapshot of what our Higgsfield integration offers, read with the free tools gpu_list_gpus, gpu_list_models and gpu_list_loras on 2026-11-27. Refresh it before planning: prices and models change.

ltx-video.licence: LTX Video Open Weights License (read before commercial use)

wan-2-2-t2v-a14b.note: Listed for L40S although its minimum is 80 GB: expect offloading and slower runs there.

minimax-h3.licence: Not stated in the catalog. Public reports say it excludes use in the US, EU, UK and South Korea: do NOT use for LifeFlow (a US company) until a lawyer reads it.

flux-2-dev.licence: FLUX non-commercial dev licence (commercial use needs a paid licence from Black Forest Labs)
flux-2-dev.path: not in the catalog: save with gpu_private_models, runs in a Supercomputer chat or by hand with gpu_rental_exec (weights cached in /workspace/hf)

loras: 34 curated LoRAs (mostly for z-image-turbo and wan-2-1-i2v), e.g. Pixel Art Style and PhotorealTouch for Z-Image Turbo, 360 Camera Orbit and Crash Zoom In for Wan 2.1 I2V. We have 0 of our own.

magi_2.measured: 8 clips of 15 s at 1080p cost 37.5 credits each (2026-11-25)

capabilities.remote_compute: kind compute: a box for shell commands (gpu_rental_exec, 90 s per call; longer work with nohup and a log).
capabilities.storage: /workspace persists across boxes (5 TB cap on our plan, 22.8 GB used). Everything else, HF_HOME included, is wiped when a box stops: cache custom weights under /workspace/hf.
capabilities.blender: kind blender_studio: full Blender with a browser desktop, scriptable with gpu_rental_exec.
capabilities.unreal: kind desktop: Unreal Editor, Nuke, DaVinci Resolve or Houdini installed per the /gpu/references presets.
capabilities.comfyui: Not a catalog item. Installable on a compute box (pip into /workspace) if a workflow needs it; the catalog models run without it.
capabilities.lora_training: Not a separate tool here: training runs on a compute box with our own script (as the skill-router training did on 2026-11-21).
capabilities.billing: By the second from ready; auto-stops after auto_pause_minutes idle (default 10). Nothing rents above the max_credits_per_hour we pass.
capabilities.where_it_runs: Only through Claude's Higgsfield tools (MCP). There is no API key for the studio's scripts, so a person or Claude runs the plan the planner prints.
